svg.title: Становая тяга с гирей между ног — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. A SUMO kettlebell deadlift with a single distinct kettlebell CENTERED BETWEEN the shoes and under the pelvis. Strict front three-quarter view shows extra-wide foot stance in both panels, knees point out, toes slightly turned outward. LEFT: hips and knees flexed, both hands grip one kettlebell's curved top handle, bell's base touches floor between the two shoes. RIGHT: standing tall with both legs extended in same wide stance, kettlebell hanging from straight arms visibly BETWEEN inner thighs, not swinging or held in front of chest. Keep wide stance different from hip-width conventional kettlebell deadlift. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
